image: R156 image, whole-graph compile (splitting_ops=[]) plus VLLM_XPU_ENABLE_XPU_GRAPH=1, cudagraph_mode FULL_DECODE_ONLY, capture sizes [1,2] (MTP1) / [1,2,3,4] (depth 3)
why: On this EPYC host the old piecewise size-1 capture was 1.1% slower (R58) and the [1,2] piecewise capture gave no c1 change (R163); the four-B70 host gained 1.77x from the same capture because its per-launch cost is high. The whole-graph compile makes a single full-step capture possible for the first time, which removes every per-kernel launch in the decode step, not only the ones inside pieces.
hypothesis: strict pair 12/12 vs sibling and vs the R187 MTP0 oracle (graph replay must be bit-identical to eager replay of the same compiled graph); c1 speed above 54.935 (MTP1) / 79.183 (depth 3) by a launch-overhead margin, or no change
decision: 12/12 and faster by >2% -> probe + two ladders, then a candidate line (publication is the user's call); 12/12 and not faster -> record, keep graphs off; any identity miss -> record as a negative, graphs stay off; a server that hangs or faults -> abort the chain, no reboot tonight, report in the morning
abort_conditions: no reboot: if a GPU fault appears, stop all further launches
